captions.detailed: A two-branch positioning fixture consisting of a vertical rectangular dark grey pillar mounted on a black rectangular base with a black top cap. On the front face of the pillar, two independent blue arm assemblies are mounted vertically spaced. Each arm is attached to a side-supported hub block containing a horizontal shaft and bearing assembly, allowing independent revolute articulation. The tips of both blue arm branches terminate in small, circular black tooling pads.
captions.instruction: Create an articulated dual-branch positioning fixture model. The model should feature a central vertical support column on a base, with two independently rotating blue arms vertically stacked on the front face. Each arm should connect via a revolute joint to a side-supported axle hub and end with a flat circular tooling pad.
captions.factory: Construct a base column assembly using rectangular boxes for the base, main pillar, and top cap. For each of the two branch arms, build a support bracket on the pillar using box primitives, add a horizontal cylindrical shaft/bearing assembly, and attach a rectangular blue arm. Terminate each arm with a small offset block and a flat cylinder representing the tooling pad. Define two revolute joints about the horizontal Y-axis to allow independent rotation of the upper and lower arms.
